span.p:
SET p, v [d]
gpio[p] ← v
other pins unchanged
takes 1 + d cycles

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;

span.p:
SHIFT_OUT [p, v] [d]
gpio[0] ← next bit, then shift:
shift_dir 0: shift_reg[0], >> 1
shift_dir 1: shift_reg[7], << 1
with p, v: gpio[p] ← v
(one edge, then hold)
takes 1 + d cycles

span.p:
PULL [d]
shift_reg ← FIFO head
pins unchanged
takes 1 + d cycles
after the stall

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;

span.p:
JMP target [d]
pins, shift_reg unchanged
takes 1 + d cycles

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;

span.p:
CONFIG_SHIFT r [d]
shift_dir ← r
pins, shift_reg unchanged
takes 1 + d cycles
